title: Number of Sub-arrays of Size K and Average Greater than or Equal to Threshold
description: Count how many sub-arrays of length k have an average value >= threshold.
pseudocode:
1. currentSum = sum of first k elements
2. count = currentSum / k >= threshold ? 1 : 0
3. for i from k to arr.length - 1:
4.   currentSum += arr[i] - arr[i - k]
5.   if currentSum / k >= threshold: count++
6. return count

steps.note: Initialize sum of first k=3 elements: [2, 2, 2] -> sum = 6
Slide window: subtract arr[0] (2), add arr[3] (8). New sum = 6 - 2 + 8 = 12
Slide window: subtract arr[1] (2), add arr[4] (4). New sum = 12 - 2 + 4 = 14
